+# Architecture
+
+**Goal:** Build a notes app: title, content, tag Work/Personal/Ideas, search by text, edit and delete
+
+**Preset:** fastapi-vanilla
+
+A SQLite table stores notes. A database module offers add, list, update, and delete functions. FastAPI routes under /api/notes call them. A single HTML page lists notes with title, content, and tag badges, a form to add one, and Edit and Delete buttons on each.
+
+## Product spec
+
+### Notes app
+
+Store notes with a title, content, and tag (Work/Personal/Ideas). Search by text, edit, and delete notes.
+
+**notes**: title (string), content (string), tag (Work / Personal / Ideas). Operations: list, create, update, delete.
+
+Features:
+- Form to add a note with title, content, and tag
+- List of notes showing title, content, and tag
+- Search by text in the notes
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every note
+
+## Endpoints
+- `POST /api/notes`: Create a new note
+- `GET /api/notes`: List all notes
+- `PUT /api/notes/{id}`: Update a note
+- `DELETE /api/notes/{id}`: Delete a note
+
+## Web page must
+- Form with title, content, and tag select (Work, Personal, Ideas) and a Save button
+- List of notes showing title, content, and tag badges
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every note
+- Show error messages from the API
+- Search box that filters the list by text as you type

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from backend.main import app

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def test_script_calls_every_endpoint():
    js = client.get('/static/app.js').text
    assert 'Q.mount' in js

    js = client.get('/static/app.js').text

    js = client.get('/static/app.js').text
